description: Patients with obsessive compulsive disorder who responded to a psychological treatment built on cognitive reframing and attentional refocusing showed significant changes in caudate nucleus metabolism and in orbitofrontal-striatal-thalamic circuitry (1990s work reviewed by Schwartz and Begley 2002, as reported in the paper).
limitations: Reported secondhand. Shows brain change after therapy, which classical accounts also allow.
